summary: Improve board evaluation, decision quality and director follow-through. Explore this practical five-day board director training course.
lede: Board leadership training helps serving and aspiring directors, board chairs and governance professionals assess board performance and strengthen oversight. Participants practise reviewing evaluation evidence, mapping director skills and scrutinizing board papers to support clearer decisions and accountable follow-through. Exercises include building a skills matrix, decision log and improvement plan, and considering board agendas and risk oversight.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for people who contribute directly to board governance, prepare board decisions or report on board performance.
prerequisites: Prior experience serving on a board or committee, supporting board governance, or preparing board-level information is recommended. Familiarity with board papers and governance responsibilities will help you apply the exercises.
